title: Cheese, Butter, Salt, Egg
label: ch:fr-cheese-butter-salt-egg
canDo: I can ask for cheese, butter, salt or an egg in French, and say why un œuf keeps its final f while les œufs drops it.

payoff.summary: Ask for an egg, hold un œuf's pronounced f against les œufs' silent one, and place œuf beside English egg as genuine cousins rather than a borrowing. Reaches back past the chapter to le sel, le beurre and le fromage, and to Chapter 29's elision rule, which l'œuf needs exactly as l'ami did.
